# acronym fixes come first; multi-token re-joins (split words glued back into
# a canonical CamelCase service brand) come last so a rejoined token is not
# Authoritative against awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml dist/ filenames at
# Upstream filenames are PascalCase with all-caps acronyms left INTACT — EC2,
# S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, EKS, ECS, EBS, EFS, ELB, SNS, SQS, SES, KMS, ECR, EMR, AZ,
# HSM, RUM, WAF, SDK — so the splitter never breaks those and they need no row
# stays "VPC", never "Vp c"). The rows below repair only the two cases the
# splitter actually mangles in this filename set:
#   (1) a mixed-case acronym followed by a lowercase letter, which the splitter
#   (2) two-word brand names AWS writes as a single CamelCase word, which the
#       splitter separates: CloudFront -> "Cloud Front", DynamoDB -> "Dynamo DB".
# ---- specific glued acronym chains the splitter cannot separate cleanly,
#      applied BEFORE the generic "Io T" rule so the longer form wins ----
